method.title: From idea to live product in four steps
method.text: A clear process, with your approval at every stage.

list.title: Understand
list.text: We talk through your project, goals, users and needs to set a clear direction.

list.title: Design
list.text: We define the structure and user experience, then create mockups for you to approve before development begins.

list.title: Build
list.text: We bring the project to life through step-by-step development, regular testing and a carefully prepared launch.

list.title: Evolve
list.text: After delivery, we can keep supporting the project, identify useful improvements and adapt it to your new needs.

list.q: How much does a website or app cost?
list.a: The price depends on complexity and features. We provide a detailed, free quote after a first conversation.
Allow a few weeks for a business website and two to four months for a mobile app, depending on scope.

list.q: Can I update my site myself?
list.a: Yes. We train your team to manage the content on their own.
Yes: updates, backups, security and new features after delivery.
